JCU Corporation.why: Sells via-filling copper plating additives and etching chemicals used to make semiconductor package substrates and PWBs; its chemicals sales rise with package-substrate demand for servers and memory, and it targets glass core substrates and interposers.
JCU Corporation.evidence: JCU 1Q FY3/27 results briefing 08-06-2026: via filling chemicals (copper plating for PWBs and semiconductor package substrates) 3,362 million yen in 1Q; Taiwan demand for semiconductor package substrates for server-related equipment remained strong; targets glass core substrates (FC-BGA) and glass interposers.

players.product: Via-filling copper plating additives and etching chemicals for PWBs and semiconductor package substrates; surface treatment (plating) chemicals targeted at next-generation package substrates (glass core substrates, glass interposers, RDL interposers)

quarterly_data.quarter: JCU Corporation results presentation: Financial Results Briefing Material for 1Q FY3/27 (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 1Q FY3/27 (JCU April-June 2026; overseas subsidiaries January-March 2026): net sales 7,492 million yen, up 6.5% year on year; operating profit 2,737 million yen, down 2.3%; profit attributable to owners of parent 2,075 million yen, up 2.5%. Chemicals Business net sales 7,057 million yen (+18.2%), segment profit 2,939 million yen (+3.4%); Machine Business net sales 435 million yen (down 59.2%).
quarterly_data.figure: 1Q net sales 7,492 million yen (+6.5%); chemicals 7,057 million yen (+18.2%)

quarterly_data.quarter: JCU Corporation results presentation: Financial Results Briefing Material for 1Q FY3/27 (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chemicals by application, 1Q FY3/27: via filling (copper plating additive for PWBs and semiconductor package substrates) 3,362 million yen, etching (additives for PWBs and semiconductor package substrates) 961 million yen, POP (plating on plastics) 1,129 million yen. Chemicals for electronic components 5,467 million yen, up 22% year on year.
quarterly_data.figure: via filling 3,362 million yen; etching 961 million yen; electronic components chemicals 5,467 million yen (YoY 22%)

quarterly_data.quarter: JCU Corporation results presentation: Financial Results Briefing Material for 1Q FY3/27 (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company: in China, demand for PWBs and semiconductor package substrates for high-performance electronic devices such as smartphones and server-related equipment remained strong (substantial year-on-year increase in chemicals sales); in Taiwan, demand for semiconductor package substrates for server-related equipment remained strong; in South Korea, rising memory demand continued the recovery in semiconductor package substrate demand (chemicals sales up substantially).

quarterly_data.signal: FY3/27 forecasts: net sales 33,400 million yen, operating profit 12,300 million yen, ordinary profit 12,500 million yen, profit attributable to owners of parent 8,800 million yen; 1H forecasts net sales 15,700 million yen and operating profit 5,900 million yen; 1Q progress 22.4% of full-year net sales.

quarterly_data.quarter: JCU Corporation results presentation: Financial Results Briefing Material for 1Q FY3/27 (08-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company's future surface-treatment targets: next-generation package substrates for AI accelerators, data centers and high-performance devices - glass core substrates (FC-BGA) and glass interposers (void-free via filling, improved via filling for thin-film layers), FO-WLP / PLP and RDL interposers (within-wafer uniformity), and hybrid bonding for memory (higher connection reliability).
